Where can I pick up my rental car when I arrive?
At the desk next to the airport exit.
The car was rented last weekend by Mr. Lopez.
You can pay by credit card or in cash.
Excuse me, is breakfast included in the room price?
Yes, it's served from six thirty to ten.
I'd like some toast and orange juice, please.
The room is on the fifth floor, near the stairs.
You've booked a double room for us, haven't you?
The double doors are made of glass.
Yes, for three nights starting on Friday.
I read a good book on the plane.
How much is a one-day pass for the city museum?
The museum closes at five on weekdays.
I passed the museum on my way here.
Fifteen euros, or ten for students.
Would you like to try this jacket in a larger size?
Yes, please. This one feels a bit tight.
The size of the shop is quite large.
I tried the soup, and it was delicious.
Why was the customer's order sent back to the warehouse?
Yes, we ordered the same items on Tuesday.
When does the last boat to the island leave tonight?
We left the boat at the harbour.
The island is famous for its long beaches.
At eight thirty, but it can be earlier in winter.
If the hotel is fully booked, where will we stay?
We could try the guesthouse across the street.
The hotel has a heated swimming pool.
I booked the hotel two months ago.
Haven't the new souvenirs arrived yet?
The souvenir shop is next to the museum.
Not yet, the supplier promised them by Friday.
Yes, I'd like a souvenir from Paris.
Could you recommend a good restaurant near the harbour?
Yes, I recommend booking a taxi.
The harbour is extremely busy in summer.
There's a seafood place two streets away, and it's very popular.
How long have you been managing this shop?
It's a small shop on the corner of the street.
I manage to finish before noon.
The tour starts at nine, but you must be at the meeting point by half past eight.
Nine tourists have signed up for it.
The meeting was cancelled this morning.
Understood, I'll set my alarm for seven.
Which counter should I go to for refunds?
Yes, the money was returned last week.
The counter is made of dark wood.
The one on the left, next to the escalator.
I'm afraid the pool is closed for cleaning until noon.
That's fine, I'll go to the gym first.
The pool opened last year in July.
I cleaned my room this morning.
Who's going to welcome the tour group this afternoon?
The group is staying for two weeks.
Marta will, as soon as the coach arrives.
Is this the cheapest room you have available?
No, there's a cheaper one for sixty euros, but it's smaller.
The room has a lovely view of the park.
I've never seen such a cheap hotel.
Did anyone leave a bag at the reception desk?
Yes, a blue one was handed in this morning.
I'd like to leave a message, please.
The reception is on the left.
Our sales have increased by twenty percent since the summer sale.
That's great news, the discounts really worked.
I saw twenty customers in the shop.
The summer was very hot this year.
Shall we take a taxi, or is the bus quicker?
Let's take the taxi, we're already late.
The bus stop is across the road.
I take a taxi every day to work.
Could we have a table by the window, please?
I'm sorry, those are reserved, but I have one near the garden.
Yes, I have a large table at home.
The window needs to be repaired.
What time is checkout on Sunday?
Eleven o'clock, but a late checkout is possible for a fee.
The flight to Lisbon was cancelled, wasn't it?
I'll fly to Lisbon next summer.
Yes, so we're rebooking everyone on tomorrow's flight.
What would you do if the supplier raised prices again?
I'd look for another supplier immediately.
The prices are listed on page four.
Are tickets for the evening show still available?
The show was reviewed in the newspaper.
Only a few seats are left in the balcony.
Yes, I'm available on Tuesday evening.
Where did the group leave their luggage?
The group is travelling with a guide.
In the storage room behind the lobby.
They left for the airport at six.
Good evening, Mr. Hale. I'm sorry, but we've overbooked tonight, and your room isn't ready.
But I reserved it three weeks ago, and I've been travelling since six this morning.
I understand. We've arranged a room at the Marlow Hotel, a five-minute walk away. We'll cover the cost and a taxi, and you'll move back here tomorrow at noon.
That's acceptable, as long as breakfast is included.
Of course. I'll call them now and confirm.
Good morning. I'm calling about the autumn collection. Your catalogue says the coats are fifty-five pounds each.
That's right, but for orders above two hundred pieces, we offer a ten percent discount.
We'd like to order two hundred and forty. Could you deliver them before the first of October?
Delivery takes about twelve days, so yes, if you confirm today.
I'll send the order form by noon.
So, the Alpine tour is eight days, and it includes all hotels and most meals.
Hmm, it's a bit expensive. Do you have anything cheaper?
There's a six-day version for nine hundred dollars, but it only covers breakfast.
Actually, that's perfect. I don't mind paying for dinners, and I can't take more than a week off work.
Great. I'll hold the booking for you until tomorrow.
Let's review last month's guest feedback. Overall scores are up, but there are complaints about noise on the third floor.
That's because of the renovation. The workers start at eight, which disturbs guests who are still asleep.
Could we ask them to start at nine-thirty? We could also offer affected guests a free breakfast.
I like both ideas. Sophie, please speak to the contractor today.
I will, and I'll also prepare a short apology note for each room.
Hi, we'd like to see the old castle today. How do we get there?
The easiest way is the number twelve bus from the square. It runs every twenty minutes and stops right in front of the main gate.
Is the castle open on Mondays?
Usually not, but this week it's open because of a festival. Tickets are cheaper if you buy them online.
Thanks. We'll buy them on my phone while we wait for the bus.
Hello, I received a lamp yesterday, but the glass shade was broken.
I'm sorry to hear that. Was the box damaged as well?
Yes, one corner was crushed. I've taken photos.
Thank you. If you send us the photos, a replacement will be shipped within two days at no cost, and you don't need to return the broken lamp.
That's very helpful. Where should I send the pictures?
To the address on your order confirmation email.
I'd like to book a table for twenty people on Saturday evening, for a retirement dinner.
For groups that size, we offer a set menu at thirty-five euros per person, with a vegetarian option.
Could we have a private room? Also, two guests are allergic to nuts.
The private room is available, but there's a small room charge. And please send me the allergy details by Thursday so the chef can prepare.
Have you seen the visitor figures for this season? We had fewer tourists in July than in June.
Yes, but last year July was the slowest month, so it's actually an improvement.
True. The weather was poor, though. If the sun had been out, we'd have had more.
Shall we launch the evening boat tours next month to attract families?
Yes, but we must advertise early. I'll draft a poster.
The winter sale starts on the second of January. Which departments will have the biggest discounts?
Clothing will go down by forty percent, and furniture by twenty-five.
I suggest we also include kitchen appliances, since we still have a lot in stock.
Agreed. I'll ask the marketing team to add them to the leaflet, which will be printed on Monday.
And we'll need extra cashiers for the first weekend.
Seaview Hotel, how can I help you?
I booked a room from the fifth to the eighth of May, but I need to move it to the following week.
Let me see. The twelfth to the fifteenth is available, though the price is a bit higher because of a local festival.
Twenty dollars a night. If you prefer, I can keep your original dates and refund the deposit.
I'll take the new dates, and I'll pay the difference at check-in.
Hello, I'm calling because our guide didn't show up this morning, and twenty guests are waiting at the hotel.
I'm very sorry. I'll find out what happened. Is there anything the guests can do in the meantime?
They've had breakfast, so perhaps a walking tour of the old town?
I'll send Paolo. He knows the area well and should be there in fifteen minutes.
Thank you. And please arrange a small gift for the group, as an apology.
Our client wants to hold a conference here for sixty guests in March.
We have the Garden Hall, which seats eighty, but the projector needs replacing before then.
And we'd have to hire extra staff for the coffee breaks, since the restaurant team can't cover both.
Shall I tell the client about the deposit? They'll have to pay thirty percent by the end of the month.
Yes, and mention that the booking isn't confirmed until we receive it.
How was your first day at the market, Joe?
Slower than I hoped. We sold only thirty jars of honey, though I'd expected about a hundred.
Maybe the sign wasn't visible. You could put a bigger banner above the stall, and offer a free sample.
Good idea. The market organizer said the crowds are usually larger on Saturdays.
Then let's print the banner tonight, and I'll help you on Saturday.

Good afternoon, guests. The hotel's swimming pool will be closed tomorrow between ten a.m. and two p.m. for its monthly cleaning. During this time, you are welcome to use the fitness centre on the second floor free of charge. The poolside café will remain open, and we apologise for any inconvenience.

Hello, Ms. Okafor, this is Brian from Horizon Travel returning your call. I've found two flights to Barcelona on the twentieth, one leaving at seven in the morning and another at four in the afternoon. The earlier one is cheaper by about sixty dollars. Please call me back by Thursday so I can hold the seats, since fares change daily.

Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the Old Town walking tour. My name is Carla, and I'll be your guide for the next two hours. We'll visit the cathedral, the central market, and the river bridge, where we'll stop for a coffee break. Please keep your belongings close, as the market can get crowded. If you get lost, call the number on your tour card.

Don't miss the grand opening of Maple Street Outlet this Saturday. Enjoy discounts of up to seventy percent on shoes, bags, and sportswear. The first one hundred customers will receive a free tote bag, and there will be live music from noon. Parking is free all weekend. Maple Street Outlet, where every day is a bargain.

Thank you for calling Bluewave Cruises. Our reservation office is currently closed. Our hours are Monday to Saturday, nine to six. If you are calling to change an existing booking, please visit our website and use your confirmation number. For urgent matters while travelling, press nine to reach our twenty-four-hour assistance line.

Before we open for the holiday season, I'd like to go over a few changes. First, the gift-wrapping counter will move to the entrance, so customers see it right away. Second, we've hired fifteen seasonal workers, who start training on Monday. Finally, please remember that, from next week, returns will only be accepted with a receipt. Any questions?

Thank you all for being here. This year, our region welcomed over two million visitors, which is a record. This success is due to the hard work of hotel staff, drivers, and guides. I'd especially like to thank Ana Ruiz, who launched our new online booking system. Thanks to her, bookings increased by thirty percent. Now, please enjoy dinner.

Here is your travel advisory. Heavy snow is expected on mountain roads tonight, and several ski resorts have advised guests to arrive before four p.m. Some shuttle buses will operate on a reduced schedule. If you have a reservation, check your resort's website before leaving. Roads should reopen fully by Wednesday morning.

Welcome to our online workshop for small hotel owners. Today I'll show you three ways to attract guests during the low season: special packages, partnerships with local restaurants, and social media promotion. Each section is about fifteen minutes, with time for questions at the end. Please keep your microphones muted until then. The slides are available on the registration page.

In local news, the city's historic market hall reopens today after eight months of renovation. The building now has air conditioning and a new roof, and about sixty vendors will return. The mayor said the project cost four million dollars and expects it to bring more tourists to the area. A festival with cooking demonstrations will take place this weekend.
